title: The Teardown 008 · Strip secrets from a HAR file
description: A 100-line standard-library script that removes cookies, tokens and map tiles from a browser recording before an AI sees it. Measured on one run: 123 requests to 39, 10.9 MB to 224 KB.
og_title: Strip secrets from a HAR file · The Teardown 008
og_description: The script that makes a browser recording safe and small before you hand it to Claude. One measured run, its first bug, and the Okta incident that shows why.
og_alt: Before and after strip_har.py: 123 requests and 10.9 MB become 39 data calls and 224 KB, with no cookie or token left.
